cards.title: About KML Format
cards.body: KML is an XML format used by Google Earth for geographic data visualization and annotation.

cards.title: About GeoJSON Format
cards.body: GeoJSON is a JSON-based format widely used in web mapping applications and modern GIS software.

cards.title: Why Convert KML to GeoJSON?
items: Better support in web mapping libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox)
Easier to parse in JavaScript applications
Native JSON structure for web APIs
